name: @aethelred/wallet-custody-adapters
description: Pluggable custody adapters for EIP-712 typed-data signing. One interface (CustodyAdapter) maps to Local, Shamir 2-of-2, Ledger HSM, AWS Nitro Enclave, and (stub) Fireblocks MPC backends. Used by @aethelred/wallet-x402 and the MCP server — same tool calls route signing to whichever backend the deployment configures. MoltPe only supports managed + Shamir 2-of-2; we cover the full enterprise custody surface.
